card.name: Plural endings on nouns
card.fires_on: The plural ending (s, or a plural noun like cards, enzymes, tubes) right after a short noun or abbreviation. It appears in both medical and general web text.

modes.label: Plural s on short nouns
modes.description: A bare s that makes an abbreviation or short noun plural.

modes.label: Plural noun after a modifier
modes.description: A plural noun such as enzymes or cards that follows a noun modifier.
